data.narrative:
EX-Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Kazuki Matsuo, Shinsuke Fujioka, and Yoshitaka Mori. The company has raised $37M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 3 public comps (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Fuse Energy, X-Energy, Oklo, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $37M raised base, yielding $74M. Peer-median analysis is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables within nuclear energy; while 4 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 meet filtering criteria for same-stage or adjacent-stage positioning at similar valuation tiers. Broadening to all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable sector-divergence risk given nuclear energy's distinct capital requirements and regulatory profile.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $63M (low) to $85M (high), with a median of $74M. This range is derived solely from stage-progression methodology. Key uncertainties include the scarcity of closely-comparable Series A nuclear companies and the absence of direct peer multiples to validate the 2.0x step-up assumption. Valuation sensitivity remains high to technology maturity assumptions and regulatory pathway clarity, neither of which are quantified in available data.
